content:
Alex: Quick heads-up — release train for Tue 2026-04-07. Need to lock deploy windows, smoke leads, and rollback owners. Tentative plan below. Reply with availability and :thumbsup: when you can own smoke.

Maya: I can lead smoke checks for window 1 (12:00-13:00 PT). I'll be available 11:45-13:30 PT.

Devon: I'll be rollback owner and on-call for 11:30-15:30 PT. I'll stage rollback tags tonight.

Sam: For runtime deploy, prefer canary 10% for 15m then 100% if green. OK?

Irene: There is a DB migration for optimizer — needs migration-before-deploy. Move optimizer to window 2 after migration completes.

Alex: Updated plan — see below.

```
Deploy window A — 12:00-13:00 PT
  - services: api-server, reranker
  - smoke lead: Maya
  - rollback owner: Devon
  - steps: deploy -> smoke checklist -> monitor 15m canary
  - deploy command: ./scripts/deploy.sh --service <svc> --tag release-20260407

Deploy window B — 14:00-15:30 PT
  - migration: optimizer DB migration (run before deploy)
  - services: optimizer, runtime
  - smoke lead: Sam
  - rollback owner: Devon
  - canary: runtime 10% for 15m then 100%
  - rollback commands:
      kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/<svc> --to-revision=<rev>
      ./scripts/rollback.sh --service <svc> --tag rollback/<tag>
```

Maya: I'll publish a one-pager smoke checklist in #eng-sre and will ping here when green.

ops-bot: scheduled release train event created for 2026-04-07 12:00 PT — calendar invite sent to @alex @maya @sam @devon

Sam: PRs blocking: #5312 (api), #5340 (runtime) — please land or reassign by EOD Mon.

Devon: If rollback needed, I'll coordinate with infra to cordon nodes and run the rollback script. FYI I have standby for 30m after each window.

Alex: Great — finalizing. I'll update the release calendar and put this plan in the release doc. If any change, flag here. :rocket:
